blocks.word/document.xml#p0090: Day 4 · After breakfast, free time until your scheduled private transfer to Rio de Janeiro International Airport. End of services.
blocks.word/document.xml#p0017: Discover the highlights of Rio de Janeiro, from its iconic landmarks and spectacular viewpoints to its legendary beaches and vibrant neighbourhoods: a perfect short escape to experience the energy and beauty of the Marvellous City, either as a standalone getaway or as an extension to a South American journey.
blocks.word/document.xml#p0066|word/document.xm:
Upon arrival at Rio de Janeiro International Airport, meet your local guide and enjoy a private transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is at leisure to relax after your journey or begin exploring the vibrant atmosphere of Rio de Janeiro at your own pace.

Optional evening experience, at an additional cost: the Rio by Night show with dinner (see Optional excursions).
blocks.word/document.xml#p0077|word/document.xm:
After breakfast, a half-day excursion to one of Rio de Janeiro’s most famous landmarks. The tour begins with a cable car ride to Sugar Loaf Mountain, stopping first at Urca Hill before continuing to the summit. From the top, enjoy spectacular panoramic views of Guanabara Bay, Copacabana Beach, the surrounding mountains, the islands scattered along the coast, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the iconic statue of Christ the Redeemer in the distance.

The excursion continues through the historic centre of Rio de Janeiro, with its colonial buildings, churches and monasteries and the impressive Metropolitan Cathedral, revealing the city’s rich history and cultural heritage. The rest of the afternoon is at leisure: relax on the beach, stroll along the famous promenades of Copacabana or Ipanema, or simply soak up the vibrant atmosphere of the Marvellous City.
blocks.word/document.xml#p0089: Day 3 · After breakfast, a half-day excursion (4 hours) through the lush Tijuca Forest, one of the largest urban forests in the world, home to an extraordinary variety of tropical flora and fauna, to the summit of Corcovado Mountain, where the magnificent Christ the Redeemer overlooks the city. Named one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, the monument offers breathtaking panoramic views of Rio de Janeiro, its famous beaches, mountains and Guanabara Bay. Optional afternoon experience, at an additional cost: a private tour of Rocinha (see Optional excursions).
